57200.meaning2: of the same race or nation

57203.commentary: (MNa) seṭṭho sajitā'ti ayaṃ lokassa uttamo ca sajitā ca. tvaṃ khattiyo nāma hohi, tvaṃ brāhmaṇo nāma, vesso nāma, suddo nāma, gahaṭṭho nāma, pabbajito nāma, antamaso oṭṭho hohi, goṇo hohī'ti evaṃ sattānaṃ visajjetā ayan'ti dasseti.

examples.text: eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.
so gantvā tena dinne aṭṭha sajīvakukkuṭe ānetvā, deva, purohitena paṇṇ'ākāro pahito'ti āha.

57206.commentary: (SNa) gāvo kamme sajīvānan'ti kammena saha jīvantānaṃ gāvo'va kamme kammasahāyā kammadutiyakā nāma honti.
57206.notes: taken by the commentary and most translations as gen pl of sajīva.

examples.text: paññā lokasmi pajjoto, sati lokasmi jāgaro, gāvo kamme sajīvānaṃ, sīt'assa iriyāpatho.
tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho āyasaṃ vajiraṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

57210.meaning1: is attached; is enmeshed; is entangled

examples.text: āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
rāgo uppatho akkhāto, vayo rattin'divakkhayo, itthī malaṃ brahmacariyassa, etth'āyaṃ sajjate pajā, tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, taṃ sinānam'anodakan'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati sajjanelaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.

57215.commentary: (CPa) sajj'assan'ti sannaddho assaṃ, yuge yojit'assaṃ me rathaṃ maggato ukkamāpanavasena ek'okāse katvā.

examples.text: ek'okāse rathaṃ katvā, sajj'assaṃ hatthamuccito, sārathī khaṇatī kāsuṃ, nikhātuṃ pathaviyā mamaṃ.

57216.meaning2: having had prepared; having caused to decorate

57217.commentary: (SNa) mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti evaṃ dhammakathaṃ ācaranto mā laggi. dhammakathaṃ kathentassa hi ekacce sādhukāraṃ dadanti, tesu rāgo uppajjati. ekacce asakkaccaṃ suṇanti, tesu paṭigho uppajjati. iti dhammakathiko anurodhavirodhesu sajjati nāma. tvaṃ evaṃ mā sajjittho'ti vadati.

examples.text: n'etaṃ tava patirūpaṃ, yadaññam'anusāsasi, anurodhavirodhesu, mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti.

57218.synonym: abhisaṅkhata, upakkhaṭa, paññatta, paṭiyatta, parikappita, vihita

57221.commentary: (MNa) seṭṭho sajitā'ti ayaṃ lokassa uttamo ca sajitā ca. tvaṃ khattiyo nāma hohi, tvaṃ brāhmaṇo nāma, vesso nāma, suddo nāma, gahaṭṭho nāma, pabbajito nāma, antamaso oṭṭho hohi, goṇo hohī'ti evaṃ sattānaṃ visajjetā ayan'ti dasseti.

examples.text: eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajjitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.

57224.meaning2: instantly, speedily, at the same moment

examples.text: na hi pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, sajju khīraṃ'va muccati, ḍahantaṃ bālam'anveti, bhasmacchanno'va pāvako.

57225.construction:
sa + √div > dya > jja + u + ka + aṃ
sajjuka + aṃ

examples.text: ayo, lohaṃ, tipu, sīsaṃ, sajjhaṃ, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya
ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti. atha kho so sahāyako sajjhabhāraṃ chaḍḍetvā suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādiyi.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. so tena sajjhāyena divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
indriyasaṃvaro brahmacariyassa āhāro, avisaṃvādanā mittānaṃ āhāro, sajjhāyakiriyā bāhusaccassa āhāro
ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yen'ekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā'pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pag'eva asajjhāyakatā?

iti kho, bhikkhu, desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. so tena sajjhāyena divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.

no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ kareyyāsi. ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha.

vacasā paricitā'ti suttadasaka-vaggadasaka-paṇṇāsadasakānaṃ vasena vācāya sajjhāyitā.

57252.meaning1: having recited; having chanted; having studied
57252.construction: saṃ + adhi > adhy > ajjh + āya + itvā

examples.text: ayo, lohaṃ, tipu, sīsaṃ, sajjhu, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya

tena hi, samma, tvañ'ca sāṇabhāraṃ chaḍḍehi, ahañ'ca sajjhubhāraṃ chaḍḍessāmi, ubho suvaṇṇabhāraṃ ādāya gamissāmā'ti. ayaṃ kho me, samma, sāṇabhāro dūr'ābhato ca susannaddho ca, alaṃ me tvaṃ pajānāhī'ti.

57256.commentary: (THIa) ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena saman'ti ekassa puggalassa ekasmiṃ kappe aṭṭhīnaṃ sañcayaṃ vepullapabbatena samaṃ upanītaṃ sara.

examples.text: sara catur'odadhī, upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi, sara ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena samaṃ.

57257.meaning1: name of an ascetic teacher; Sañcaya Belaṭṭhaputta

examples.text: ye'pi te, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyath'idaṃ, pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto, pakudho kaccāyano, ajito kesakambalo
ayam'pi kho sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto saṅghī c'eva gaṇī ca gaṇ'ācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.

57259.meaning1: busy street; crowded place; meeting place; square

examples.text: ajjhattabahiddhā vā'ti kālena attano, kālena parassa assāsapassāsakāye. eten'assa paguṇakammaṭṭhānaṃ aṭṭhapetvā apar'āparaṃ sañcaraṇakālo kathito. ekasmiṃ kāle pan'idaṃ ubhayaṃ na labbhati.

57261.meaning1: near to a busy street; close to a crowded place

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, ete manussā gehaṃ pavisanti, ete nikkhamanti, ete rathikāya vīthiṃ sañcaranti, ete majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinnā'ti.

57264.commentary: (DNa) vīthiṃ sañcarante'ti apar'āparaṃ sañcarante. vīthiṃ carante'ti'pi pāṭho. ayam'ev'attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, majjhe siṅghāṭake pāsādo. tattha cakkhumā puriso ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi rathikāya'pi vīthiṃ sañcarante majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinne'pi.

sañcara + tta
57267.commentary: (VIN 1.2.5) sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyyā'ti itthiyā vā pahito purisassa santike gacchati, purisena vā pahito itthiyā santike gacchati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅ'khaṇikāya'pi, saṅgh'ādiseso.

57268.meaning2: (offences of) matchmaking and recitation of the dhamma word by word, etc.

57270.meaning2: having gone about, having wandered, having moved

57283.commentary:
(VIN 2.5.7.1) sañciccā'ti jānanto sañjānanto cecca abhivitaritvā vītikkamo.
(VINa) tassa sañcetetvā suṭṭhu cetetvā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

57284.meaning1: rule about intentionally (killing a living being); Pācittiya 61

57287.commentary: (VINa) padarasañcitaṃ hotī'ti yassā uparimatalaṃ dāruphalakehi vā ghanasanthataṃ hoti, sudhādiparikammakataṃ vā tatthā'pi anāpatti. (KVt) uparitalaṃ vā padarasañcitan'ti uparimatalaṃ dāruphalakehi ghanasanthataṃ.

57297.grammar: fem, abstr, act, in comps, from sañceteti
57297.meaning1: wishing; intending; willing; making a choice

examples.text: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ
katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

57298.meaning1: class of intentions; category of choices
57298.meaning2: category of choice, class of volition
